## findings

1. **SOURCE-POLICY RED — two policies claim this cancellation.** Root cause PT-R1. Evidence: annual rule "every other immediate cancellation keeps the base measure …" vs Business closure rule "For the immediate cancellation of a Northgate+ Business membership whose most recent settled annual fee was charged to an external card, and only for such a cancellation …"; seed fee eaae1825 external_card, benefit use 594a7c84 2026-05-29. Consequence: 89.83 / prorated_unused_months vs 34.58 / full_within_window. Affected: both refund rules and overwrites; step 14.
2. **SOURCE-POLICY RED — hold-day count boundary.** Root cause PT-R8. Consequence: 34.85 (6 days) vs 34.58 (5 days). Affected: Business closure "Hold-day credit" sentence; step 14.
3. **SOURCE-POLICY RED — in-force "benefits already used are never billed back".** Root cause PT-R2. Consequence: 36.62 or 96.41 vs 34.58. Step 14.
4. **SOURCE-POLICY RED — Cash-recovery grouping.** Root cause PT-R9. Consequence: 94.37 vs 34.58. Step 14.
5. **SOURCE-FACTOR RED — Business earning has no valid method factor.** Root cause PT-R11 (business_kept_units ≡ net − R − M; here R = 338.53, M = 0). Step 8.
6. **SOURCE-FACTOR RED — unreturned_reason_relief.** Root cause PT-R12: the schedule only settles damaged/never-received refunds, so the "otherwise" tier and the 0 baseline are unreachable; on this world the tier (damaged, refund c7793dee) is one of the two reachable values. Step 12.
7. Charter-level REDs with no consequence here (PT-R3 no second state on this world, PT-R4, R5, R6, R7, R10, R13) and observations O-1…O-8 are in `_difficulty.md`.
